versions.changelog: Add auto-ensure-session (self-drive one-time device login; no auth dead-stop).

- Initial release of metered-data-fetch.
- Provides access to paid data APIs (web search, scraping, SEO/SERP, finance data, LLMs) with one SettleMesh key.
- No need for separate data-provider signups or BYOK—per-call metering with cost quotes up front.
- First call to each capability is free; only pay for repeat usage.
- Requires settlemesh CLI and a SETTLE_API_KEY for authentication.
- Enables discovery, quoting, and calling of data APIs directly from the CLI.
